note: Severities, priorities and weights are opinionated defaults. Evidence classes: A official documentation, B deterministic spec/structure check, C heuristic, D experimental (never penalizes a score). Status planned rules are catalogued but not emitted.

rules.title: robots.txt not found (all paths crawlable by default)
rules.fix_hint: Add a /robots.txt that states the crawl policy and lists the sitemap; a missing file is valid but leaves the policy implicit.

rules.title: robots.txt exceeds 500 KiB; content after the limit is ignored
rules.fix_hint: Shrink robots.txt below 500 KiB by merging patterns with wildcards; Google ignores rules after the limit.

rules.title: Unsupported robots.txt field ignored by Google (crawl-delay, noindex, host …)
rules.fix_hint: Remove fields Google ignores (crawl-delay, noindex, host) or keep them only for other crawlers; control indexing with robots meta or X-Robots-Tag.

rules.title: All crawlers disallowed from the whole site
rules.fix_hint: Remove the site-wide Disallow: / for User-agent: * unless the site must stay out of every crawler; confirm the intent with the owner.

rules.title: CSS/JS/image assets needed for rendering are disallowed
rules.fix_hint: Allow crawling of the CSS, JavaScript and image paths that pages need to render.

rules.title: Sitemap line missing or not an absolute URL
rules.fix_hint: Add a Sitemap: line with an absolute https:// URL for each sitemap or sitemap index.

rules.title: Rule path contains spaces or non-ASCII (percent-encode)
rules.fix_hint: Percent-encode spaces and non-ASCII characters in robots.txt rule paths.

rules.title: Page is noindex but disallowed in robots.txt (noindex cannot be seen)
rules.fix_hint: Allow crawling of pages that carry noindex so crawlers can see it, or drop noindex if the block is intended.
rules.notes: Emitted by robots.check_blocked_noindex with noindex URLs supplied by cli.

rules.title: Rule outside any user-agent group or malformed line
rules.fix_hint: Place every Allow and Disallow line under a User-agent line and fix malformed lines.

rules.title: Page is noindex
rules.fix_hint: Remove noindex from pages meant to appear in search, or confirm with the owner that the page should stay out of the index.

rules.title: Conflicting robots directives (most restrictive applies)
rules.fix_hint: Emit one consistent robots directive set per page; search engines apply the most restrictive combination.

rules.title: noarchive/nocache/nositelinkssearchbox are ignored by Google
rules.fix_hint: Drop directives Google ignores, or keep them only for other engines and document why.

rules.title: X-Robots-Tag noindex from platform headers config
rules.fix_hint: Remove the X-Robots-Tag noindex rule from the headers config for paths that should be indexed.

rules.title: unavailable_after date is in the past
rules.fix_hint: Update or remove the expired unavailable_after directive if the page should stay indexed.

rules.title: Missing canonical link
rules.fix_hint: Add one absolute, self-referencing rel=canonical link in the page head.

rules.title: Multiple canonical links
rules.fix_hint: Emit a single absolute rel=canonical from one place in the layout.

rules.title: Canonical relative, malformed, non-http(s) or with credentials
rules.fix_hint: Use an absolute http(s) canonical URL without credentials, spaces or fragments.

rules.title: Canonical target missing, noindex, redirecting or non-200 in the site
rules.fix_hint: Point the canonical at a live, indexable URL that returns 200 without redirecting.

rules.title: Canonical points to a different URL
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the page duplicates the canonical target; otherwise make the canonical self-referencing.

rules.title: Paginated page canonicalizes to page 1
rules.fix_hint: Give each paginated page its own self-referencing canonical.

rules.title: Canonical crosses languages inside an hreflang cluster
rules.fix_hint: Canonicalize each language version to itself or a same-language URL, never to another language.

rules.title: Canonical differs from mapped URL only by trailing slash (verify host config)
rules.fix_hint: Check which slash form the host serves and redirects to, then make the canonical match the served URL.

rules.title: Page returns 4xx/5xx (live)
rules.fix_hint: Fix the route or server error, or remove internal links and sitemap entries that point to it.

rules.title: Redirect chain longer than one hop (live)
rules.fix_hint: Redirect straight to the final URL and update internal links to point at it.

rules.title: Temporary redirect (302/303/307) for an apparently permanent move
rules.fix_hint: Use 301 or 308 for permanent moves.

rules.title: Unknown URL returns 200 (soft 404) (live)
rules.fix_hint: Return 404 or 410 for unknown URLs instead of a 200 page.
rules.notes: Emitted by robots.access_check from a random-path probe.

rules.title: HTML larger than 2 MB uncompressed (Googlebot reads the first 2 MB)
rules.fix_hint: Cut HTML size (inlined data, repeated markup) so key content and links fall within the first 2 MB.

rules.title: Missing security headers (hygiene only)
rules.fix_hint: Add standard security headers as hygiene; they are not presented as a ranking factor.

rules.title: Non-HTTPS page or mixed content
rules.fix_hint: Serve the page over HTTPS and load every subresource over HTTPS.

rules.title: 401/403/429 served to the audit crawler
rules.fix_hint: Check WAF and bot rules: crawlers that receive 401, 403 or 429 cannot index the page; do not throttle crawlers with 4xx.

rules.title: Missing or empty title element
rules.fix_hint: Add a unique, descriptive title element in the head of every indexable page.

rules.title: Placeholder or framework-default title
rules.fix_hint: Replace default titles such as "Create Next App" or "Untitled" with a page-specific title.

rules.title: Duplicate title across pages
rules.fix_hint: Make each title unique by naming what distinguishes the page.

rules.title: Missing meta description
rules.fix_hint: Add a page-specific meta description; Google may still write its own snippet.

rules.title: Duplicate meta description across pages
rules.fix_hint: Write a distinct description per page, or omit it instead of repeating one.

rules.title: Templated metadata pattern (site-level)
rules.fix_hint: Rewrite templated title and description pairs so each page states its own specifics instead of a swapped keyword.
rules.notes: Emitted by content.check_site_text with title/description pairs supplied by cli.

rules.title: Multiple title elements in head
rules.fix_hint: Render exactly one title element; remove duplicates added by layouts or plugins.

rules.title: Missing html lang
rules.fix_hint: Set the html lang attribute for accessibility and browsers; Google does not use it to detect language.

rules.title: Missing or invalid viewport meta
rules.fix_hint: Add a viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

rules.title: Incomplete Open Graph basics (og:title, og:image, og:url)
rules.fix_hint: Add og:title, og:image and og:url for link previews; treat them as display inputs, not ranking factors.

rules.title: Title may be truncated on typical displays (hint; no limit exists)
rules.fix_hint: Put the distinguishing words first; Google sets no title length limit but truncates to the device width.

rules.title: Obsolete year in title or H1
rules.fix_hint: Update or remove the stale year unless the content was reviewed for it.

rules.title: meta keywords present (ignored by Google)
rules.fix_hint: Remove the meta keywords tag; Google does not use it.

rules.title: og:url differs from canonical
rules.fix_hint: Set og:url to the canonical URL.

rules.title: No H1
rules.fix_hint: Add one visible H1 that states the page topic.

rules.title: Skipped heading levels
rules.fix_hint: Use heading levels in order (H2 under H1, H3 under H2) for a clear outline.

rules.title: Content page without headings
rules.fix_hint: Split long content into sections with descriptive headings.

rules.title: Malformed JSON in JSON-LD block
rules.fix_hint: Fix the JSON syntax; serialize JSON-LD with a JSON encoder instead of string templates.

rules.title: JSON-LD root or node is not an object (incl. nested arrays)
rules.fix_hint: Make each JSON-LD root an object, an array of objects or an @graph of objects.

rules.title: Entity missing @context (none inherited)
rules.fix_hint: Add "@context": "https://schema.org" at the root or on each top-level entity.

rules.title: Entity missing @type
rules.fix_hint: Give every entity a schema.org @type.

rules.title: @context or @type has the wrong kind
rules.fix_hint: Use a string or array of strings for @type and a valid @context value.

rules.title: Unreplaced placeholder value in structured data
rules.fix_hint: Replace template placeholders with real values shown on the page, or remove the property.

rules.title: Type or feature has no Google rich result (retired or never)
rules.fix_hint: Keep the markup only if it describes the page truthfully; do not expect a Google rich result for this type.

rules.title: Missing Google-required property for a rich-result feature
rules.fix_hint: Add the required property with a value visible on the page, or drop that feature's markup.

rules.title: Missing Google-recommended property
rules.fix_hint: Add recommended properties only when the page really provides that information.

rules.title: Self-serving review or rating on LocalBusiness/Organization
rules.fix_hint: Remove review or rating markup that the business publishes about itself.

rules.title: AggregateRating with zero/non-numeric counts or out-of-range rating
rules.fix_hint: Use a numeric ratingValue within the rating range and a ratingCount or reviewCount above zero, or remove the rating.

rules.title: "</script" or unescaped "<" breakout risk inside JSON-LD
rules.fix_hint: Escape every < as \u003c when serializing JSON-LD into HTML.

rules.title: Relative or non-http URL in a URL-valued property
rules.fix_hint: Use absolute https:// URLs in url, @id, image, logo and sameAs.

rules.title: Date not ISO 8601
Conflicting entities share the same @id
rules.fix_hint: Use one @id per real-world entity and keep its properties consistent across pages.

rules.title: Marked-up value not found in visible text
rules.fix_hint: Mark up only information that is visible on the page.

rules.title: Merchant-listing offer lacks price > 0 or priceCurrency
rules.fix_hint: Give each offer a price above zero and an ISO 4217 priceCurrency.
rules.notes: Profile ecommerce applies stricter merchant checks.

rules.title: Template serializes JSON-LD without escaping "<"
rules.fix_hint: Replace < with \u003c after JSON.stringify before injecting JSON-LD into the page.

rules.title: JSON-LD block skipped: template expression (validate built output)
rules.fix_hint: Validate the rendered HTML with audit-build or jsonld on build output; template expressions cannot be checked in source.

rules.title: Microdata/RDFa only (JSON-LD recommended)
rules.fix_hint: Consider JSON-LD for new markup; valid Microdata or RDFa keeps working.
rules.notes: Emitted with page flags supplied by cli.

rules.title: No sitemap found
rules.fix_hint: Generate an XML sitemap of canonical, indexable URLs and reference it from robots.txt.

rules.title: Sitemap exceeds 50,000 URLs or 50 MB uncompressed
rules.fix_hint: Split the sitemap into files under 50,000 URLs and 50 MB and list them in a sitemap index.

rules.title: Sitemap is not valid XML, or DTD/entity refused
rules.fix_hint: Emit well-formed UTF-8 XML with the sitemap namespace and no DOCTYPE or entity declarations.

rules.title: Non-absolute, wrong-host or non-http(s) loc
rules.fix_hint: List absolute http(s) URLs on the sitemap's own host.

rules.title: Invalid lastmod format
rules.fix_hint: Write lastmod in W3C Datetime format (YYYY-MM-DD or a full timestamp with time zone).

rules.title: lastmod likely inaccurate (identical, future, or build time)
rules.fix_hint: Set lastmod from each page's real content change date, not the build time.

rules.title: priority/changefreq present (ignored by Google and Bing)
rules.fix_hint: Remove priority and changefreq, or keep them knowing Google and Bing ignore them.

rules.title: Sitemap lists missing, noindex, non-canonical or redirecting URL
rules.fix_hint: List only canonical, indexable URLs that return 200.

rules.title: Indexable built page missing from sitemap
rules.fix_hint: Add indexable canonical pages to the sitemap, or confirm they are excluded on purpose.

rules.title: Image sitemap uses removed tags or >1,000 images per URL
rules.fix_hint: Keep only image:image and image:loc, with at most 1,000 images per URL.

rules.title: Sitemap index references a missing sitemap
rules.fix_hint: Fix or remove sitemap index entries that point to missing files.

rules.title: Invalid hreflang code
rules.fix_hint: Use an ISO 639-1 language code with an optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region (en-GB, not en-UK), or x-default.

rules.title: Missing self-referencing hreflang
rules.fix_hint: Include the page itself in its own hreflang set.

rules.title: Missing return link (non-reciprocal pair is ignored)
rules.fix_hint: Add the reverse hreflang link on the target page so every pair is reciprocal.

rules.title: No x-default in cluster
rules.fix_hint: Add an x-default alternate for users who match none of the listed languages.

rules.title: Relative hreflang URL
rules.fix_hint: Use absolute URLs in hreflang annotations.

rules.title: hreflang target missing, noindex or non-canonical
rules.fix_hint: Point hreflang only at canonical, indexable URLs that return 200.

rules.title: Duplicate language code in one page's set
rules.fix_hint: List each language-region code once per page.

rules.title: html lang differs from the page's own hreflang
rules.fix_hint: Align the html lang attribute with the page's own hreflang code.

rules.title: Broken internal link
rules.fix_hint: Fix or remove internal links to URLs that do not exist in the build.

rules.title: Orphan candidate (in sitemap, no internal inlinks)
rules.fix_hint: Link to the page from relevant pages or navigation, or remove it from the sitemap.

rules.title: Page deeper than 3 clicks from home
rules.fix_hint: Link important pages from hub pages so they sit within a few clicks of the home page.

rules.title: Non-crawlable link (javascript:, missing href, #/ route)
rules.fix_hint: Use a elements with a real href for navigation instead of javascript: links or click handlers.

rules.title: High share of generic anchor text
rules.fix_hint: Describe the target in the anchor text instead of "click here" or "read more".

rules.title: Internal link to a redirecting URL
rules.fix_hint: Link directly to the final URL.

rules.title: Internal links marked nofollow
rules.fix_hint: Remove rel=nofollow from internal links unless they lead to pages that should not be crawled.

rules.title: Client-rendered shell: almost no server HTML text in app root
rules.fix_hint: Render primary content and links in server HTML (SSR, SSG or prerendering); dynamic rendering is only a workaround.
rules.notes: Escalation to P0 site-wide applies on the home page.

rules.title: Thin server HTML relative to scripts (likely client-rendered content)
rules.fix_hint: Move primary content into the server-rendered HTML and check the raw response, not the browser DOM.

rules.title: Content only inside noscript
rules.fix_hint: Render the content in normal HTML instead of only inside noscript.

rules.title: Hash-fragment routes used as links
rules.fix_hint: Use History API routes with real paths instead of #/ fragment URLs.

rules.title: SPA fallback page serves unknown routes
rules.fix_hint: Return 404 (or add noindex) for unknown routes instead of serving the app shell with status 200.

rules.title: Image without width/height or aspect-ratio (CLS risk)
rules.fix_hint: Set width and height attributes (or CSS aspect-ratio) on images to reserve their space.

rules.title: Likely LCP image is lazy-loaded
rules.fix_hint: Remove loading=lazy from the main above-the-fold image.

rules.title: Likely LCP image lacks fetchpriority or preload
rules.fix_hint: Consider fetchpriority=high on the main hero image and confirm the effect with field or lab data.

rules.title: Render-blocking script in head
rules.fix_hint: Add defer or async to head scripts that are not needed before first render.

rules.title: unload/beforeunload listener (bfcache blocker)
rules.fix_hint: Replace unload handlers with pagehide or visibilitychange so the page can use the back/forward cache.

rules.title: Deprecated rel=prerender
rules.fix_hint: Replace rel=prerender with Speculation Rules or remove it.

rules.title: Heavy HTML document (>1 MB)
rules.fix_hint: Reduce HTML weight by removing inlined data and repeated markup.

rules.title: Field Core Web Vitals metric needs improvement or poor
rules.fix_hint: Investigate the failing metric with CrUX field data, fix its main cause and recheck after the 28-day window.

rules.title: Only lab data available (no field data)
rules.fix_hint: Add CrUX field data (API or History) before judging Core Web Vitals; lab scores are diagnostics.

rules.title: Image missing alt attribute
rules.fix_hint: Add alt text that describes the image, or an empty alt for purely decorative images.

rules.title: Alt text looks like a filename or keyword list
rules.fix_hint: Write alt text that describes the image in plain words.

rules.title: Content image as data: URI
rules.fix_hint: Serve content images as crawlable files with their own URLs instead of data: URIs.

rules.title: Large photo without modern format alternative
rules.fix_hint: Offer WebP or AVIF versions of large photos through picture or srcset.

rules.title: Apparent watch page without VideoObject
rules.fix_hint: Add VideoObject markup with name, thumbnailUrl and uploadDate on video watch pages.

rules.title: Quantitative or authority claim without nearby citation
rules.fix_hint: Cite a source next to the claim, or remove the claim if it cannot be supported.

rules.title: High filler-phrase density (style signal)
rules.fix_hint: Cut filler phrases so each sentence carries information; this is a style signal, not AI detection.

rules.title: Invisible, bidi-control or tag characters in content
rules.fix_hint: Remove zero-width, bidi-control and Unicode tag characters from published text.

rules.title: Leftover AI, editor or template artifacts in published text
rules.fix_hint: Remove assistant self-references, unfilled placeholders, TODO markers and stray formatting before publishing.

rules.title: Stale year or undated "updated" claim
rules.fix_hint: Show a real last-reviewed date, or remove the stale year and the unsupported "updated" claim.

rules.title: Thin content for page type (heuristic)
rules.fix_hint: Expand the page with information users need, or consolidate it into a stronger page.

rules.title: Paragraphs open with dangling references (it/this/these)
rules.fix_hint: Name the subject at the start of paragraphs so each passage stands on its own.

rules.title: Unsupported superlatives or hype density
rules.fix_hint: Replace unsupported superlatives with specific, verifiable statements.

rules.title: Orphan citation markers with no target
rules.fix_hint: Link each citation marker to its source or remove the marker.

rules.title: Text addressed to AI systems with instructions (prompt-injection pattern), hidden or visible
rules.fix_hint: Remove instructions aimed at AI systems; manipulating generative AI responses violates Google's spam policies.

rules.title: Low passage citability (heuristic)
rules.fix_hint: Make key passages self-contained: state the subject, the answer and its supporting fact together.

rules.title: Question heading not answered in the first sentences
rules.fix_hint: Answer the heading's question in the first one or two sentences under it.

rules.title: No self-contained passages between 40 and 300 words
rules.fix_hint: Add at least one focused passage that answers a core question in one place.

rules.title: Near-duplicate pages (shingle similarity ≥ 0.85)
rules.fix_hint: Merge near-duplicate pages or add unique, useful information to each; scaled near-duplicates risk scaled content abuse.
rules.notes: Emitted by content.check_site_text with page texts supplied by cli.

rules.title: Phrase shared by >30% of pages in a section
rules.fix_hint: Replace boilerplate phrasing repeated across a section with page-specific content.

rules.title: Many thin templated pages in one section
rules.fix_hint: Consolidate thin templated pages, or keep them out of the index until each offers unique value.

rules.title: AI search/answer indexer blocked by a named group (visibility impact)
rules.fix_hint: Confirm with the owner that leaving that AI search product is intended; allow the indexer token to stay eligible.

rules.title: Training-only crawler blocked (no search impact)
rules.fix_hint: No change needed if the training opt-out is intended; this block does not remove the site from search.

rules.title: Rule targets a user-triggered fetcher that may ignore robots.txt
rules.fix_hint: Do not rely on robots.txt for user-triggered fetchers; use authentication or WAF rules if access must be blocked.

rules.title: Googlebot or Bingbot blocked (removes Search and AI features)
rules.fix_hint: Unblock Googlebot and Bingbot; express AI-training choices with Google-Extended or Bingbot directives instead.

rules.title: Malformed Content-Signal or unknown key
rules.fix_hint: Write Content-Signal as comma-separated key=yes or key=no pairs using search, ai-input and ai-train.

rules.title: Named group lacks a Content-Signal present in the * group
rules.fix_hint: Repeat the Content-Signal line in named groups; a named group does not inherit lines from the * group.

rules.title: Shared AI-training preference token present (scope and dates explained)
rules.fix_hint: Keep the __usage_ai-training group if intended; adoption dates differ by vendor and it states a preference, not access control.

rules.title: `User-agent: *` rule assumed to express an AI-training preference
rules.fix_hint: State AI-training preferences with __usage_ai-training or vendor tokens; User-agent: * does not match the policy token.

rules.title: Cloudflare-managed robots block detected (edge-injected rules)
rules.fix_hint: Review the Cloudflare managed robots.txt and AI crawler settings; edge rules can differ from the file in the repository.

rules.title: Snippet controls limit Google AI Overviews/AI Mode input
rules.fix_hint: Keep nosnippet or max-snippet only if limiting use in AI Overviews and AI Mode is intended.
rules.notes: Emitted by robots.check_page_ai_directives with page directives supplied by cli.

rules.title: noarchive/nocache used as AI control (Google ignores; Bing until 2027-03-01)
rules.fix_hint: Use Google-Extended and Bingbot ai-training or ai-grounding directives instead; Bing stops reading these as AI signals on 2027-03-01.
rules.notes: Emitted by robots.check_page_ai_directives with page directives supplied by cli.

rules.title: Bingbot ai-training/ai-grounding directive (honored from 2027-02-01)
rules.fix_hint: Keep the directive if intended; Bing honors it from 2027-02-01.
rules.notes: Emitted by robots.check_page_ai_directives with page directives supplied by cli.

rules.title: Edge Content-Signal header contradicts robots.txt (live)
rules.fix_hint: Align the CDN Content-Signal header (for example Markdown for Agents defaults) with robots.txt.

rules.title: AI search indexer blocked only via the * group (no explicit decision)
rules.fix_hint: Add explicit groups for AI search indexers such as OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot to record the decision.

rules.title: robots.txt returns 5xx or is unreachable (treated as full disallow) (live)
rules.fix_hint: Make /robots.txt return 200, or 404 when there is none; server errors make crawlers stop crawling.

rules.title: No llms.txt (optional; informational only)
rules.fix_hint: Optional: add llms.txt for agents and tools that read it; Google Search ignores it.

rules.title: llms.txt structure invalid (e.g., no H1)
rules.fix_hint: Start llms.txt with an H1 title and use H2 sections with Markdown link lists.

rules.title: llms.txt link relative, malformed or missing from site
rules.fix_hint: Use absolute URLs in llms.txt that exist on the site.

rules.title: llms.txt served as HTML (soft 404) (live)
rules.fix_hint: Serve llms.txt as text/plain or text/markdown, or return 404 when it does not exist.

rules.title: Markdown alternate declared but target missing
rules.fix_hint: Publish the declared Markdown alternate or remove the rel=alternate link.

rules.title: Interactive elements without accessible names / div onclick
rules.fix_hint: Use native buttons and links with accessible names instead of clickable div elements.

rules.title: Invalid JSON or HTML soft 404 at a /.well-known/ document (live)
rules.fix_hint: Serve valid JSON at the /.well-known/ paths you publish, or return 404.

rules.title: llms-full.txt present (community convention, not spec)
rules.fix_hint: Keep llms-full.txt only if it is maintained; it is a community convention outside the llms.txt spec.

rules.title: History manipulation on page load (back-button hijacking risk)
rules.fix_hint: Remove history.pushState or replaceState calls that add entries on load; back-button hijacking is a spam policy violation.

rules.title: Meta refresh redirect
rules.fix_hint: Replace the meta refresh with a server-side 301 or 308 redirect.

rules.title: Crawler user-agent sniffing in inline scripts (cloaking risk)
rules.fix_hint: Serve crawlers and users the same content; remove user-agent sniffing that changes it.

rules.title: Inconsistent name/address/phone across pages or LocalBusiness markup
rules.fix_hint: Use one consistent business name, address and phone format across pages and markup.

rules.title: Link to retired Google Business Profile feature (chat, business.site)
rules.fix_hint: Remove links to retired Business Profile chat or business.site websites.

rules.title: Home page lacks title, description, self-canonical or Organization/WebSite JSON-LD
rules.fix_hint: Give the home page a title, description, self-canonical and Organization or WebSite JSON-LD before launch.

rules.title: No reachable About or Contact page
rules.fix_hint: Link an About or Contact page from the home page so visitors can see who runs the site.

rules.title: localhost, staging or preview URLs in canonical, og:url, hreflang, sitemap or JSON-LD
rules.fix_hint: Replace localhost, staging and preview hosts with the production origin in every emitted URL.

rules.title: Site-wide noindex or staging robots shipped
rules.fix_hint: Remove staging noindex and Disallow rules from the production build after confirming with the owner.

rules.title: No custom 404 page, or 404 page indexable/listed in sitemap
rules.fix_hint: Add a helpful 404 page served with status 404 and keep it out of the sitemap.

rules.title: Page removed or status changed from 2xx to 4xx/5xx
rules.fix_hint: Restore the page, or redirect it to its closest replacement, before release.

rules.title: noindex added
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the new noindex is intended; otherwise remove it before release.

rules.title: Canonical changed
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the new canonical is intended and points to a live, indexable URL.

rules.title: Canonical removed
rules.fix_hint: Restore the canonical link unless its removal is intended.

rules.title: Title removed
rules.fix_hint: Restore the title element.

rules.title: H1 removed
rules.fix_hint: Restore the H1 or confirm the template change.

rules.title: H1 changed substantially (similarity < 0.5)
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the new H1 still matches the page's purpose.

rules.title: Title changed
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the title change is intended and watch query and click data after release.

rules.title: Meta description changed
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the description change is intended.

rules.title: JSON-LD types removed (retired types downgrade to I)
rules.fix_hint: Restore removed structured data unless the type is retired or was dropped on purpose.
rules.notes: Removal of types without a Google rich result is reported as info.

rules.title: JSON-LD types added
rules.fix_hint: Validate the new structured data before release.

rules.title: hreflang set changed
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the hreflang change is intended and still reciprocal.

rules.title: Robots meta or X-Robots-Tag changed (other than noindex)
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the directive change is intended.

rules.title: All Open Graph tags removed
rules.fix_hint: Restore the Open Graph tags used for link previews.

rules.title: Word count dropped by more than 50%
rules.fix_hint: Check that content was not lost in a template or rendering change.

rules.title: Internal outlinks dropped by more than 50%
rules.fix_hint: Check navigation and body links for accidental removal.

rules.title: Content hash changed
rules.fix_hint: No change needed unless the content change is unexpected.

rules.title: New page added
rules.fix_hint: Confirm the new page should be indexable and listed in the sitemap.

rules.title: robots.txt changed
rules.fix_hint: Review the robots.txt diff with the owner before release.

rules.title: Snapshots not comparable (deltas withheld)
rules.fix_hint: Capture a new baseline with the same source type, base URL and major version, then compare again.

rules.title: Redirect chain (>1 hop) in map
rules.fix_hint: Point each old URL straight at its final destination.

rules.title: Redirect loop
rules.fix_hint: Break the loop so every old URL ends at a live page.

rules.title: Redirect destination missing in new build
rules.fix_hint: Fix destinations so each one exists in the new build.

rules.title: Temporary status for a permanent move
rules.fix_hint: Use 301 or 308 for permanent moves.

rules.title: Many URLs redirected to the home page (soft-404 risk)
rules.fix_hint: Redirect old URLs to their closest equivalent page, and return 404 or 410 when none exists.

rules.title: Old URL neither present in new build nor redirected
rules.fix_hint: Add a redirect for the old URL or keep the page in the new build.

rules.title: Malformed map row or duplicate source URL
rules.fix_hint: Give each row one absolute old_url and new_url and remove duplicate source URLs.

rules.title: Rewrite changed a heading (heading_changed)
rules.fix_hint: Keep headings exactly as in the original; rewrite only the body text.

rules.title: Rewrite removed a link (link_removed)
rules.fix_hint: Restore every link from the original section.

rules.title: Rewrite added a link (link_added)
rules.fix_hint: Remove links the original did not contain unless the owner supplied them.

rules.title: Rewrite removed a number (number_removed)
rules.fix_hint: Restore the numbers, dates and figures from the original.

rules.title: Rewrite added a number (number_added)
rules.fix_hint: Remove numbers that are not in the original; never invent statistics.

rules.title: Rewrite dropped table rows (table_rows_decreased)
rules.fix_hint: Restore every table row from the original.

rules.title: Rewrite changed a code block (code_block_changed)
rules.fix_hint: Keep code blocks byte-identical to the original.

rules.title: Rewrite length outside the allowed range (too_short/too_long)
rules.fix_hint: Keep the rewrite within the allowed length ratio of the original.

rules.title: Rewrite added a superlative (superlative_added)
rules.fix_hint: Remove superlatives that the original did not make.

rules.title: Rewrite removed a caveat (caveat_removed)
rules.fix_hint: Restore the caveats and qualifiers from the original.
